About Us

PRECISION AT THE CORE OF EVERY SCREW

Laxminarayan Steel Industries, established in 2008, is a trusted manufacturer and supplier of high-quality stainless steel fasteners based in Wadhwan City, Surendranagar, Gujarat. With years of industry experience and a strong focus on precision engineering, we cater to a wide range of industrial applications.

Our products are manufactured using premium-grade raw materials, ensuring durability, corrosion resistance and superior performance. Backed by advanced infrastructure and strict quality control systems, we deliver products that consistently meet international standards for dealers, exporters and industrial clients.

Our Commitment to Excellence

High-Precision EngineeringAccurate threads and consistent manufacturing for a perfect fit.
Strict Quality Control at Every StageInspection at multiple stages of manufacturing.
Wide Product RangeScrews, machine screws and special fasteners in many head and drive styles.
Custom Manufacturing AvailableMade to client specifications and drawings.
Timely Delivery & Reliable SupplyDependable supply for dealers, exporters and industry.

Quality Assurance

Quality is at the core of our operations. Each product undergoes strict inspection at multiple stages of manufacturing. Our dedicated quality control team ensures compliance with international standards and customer specifications. We are ISO 9001:2008 certified, reflecting our commitment to consistent quality across every batch.

Infrastructure

Our manufacturing unit is equipped with modern machinery and advanced tools that enable us to produce high-quality fasteners with consistency and efficiency. The facility is designed to handle both large-scale production and custom, specialised orders.

Key Product Features

  • Sharp threads for faster installation
  • Strong grip and high holding power
  • Precision manufacturing for perfect fitting
  • Corrosion-resistant stainless steel construction
  • Suitable for industrial and heavy-duty applications
  • DIN / ISO compliant across all product lines
  • Multiple thread types: BSW, MM, UNC, UNF, AB, B
  • Custom manufacturing to client specifications

How to Choose the Right Grade

204CuEnhanced cold-forming and heading properties; good corrosion resistance at a competitive cost.

304Most widely used grade: food processing, pharmaceutical, marine and heavy industrial applications.

316Marine grade for harsh, chloride-rich and high-salinity environments and chemical exposure.

CSK Phillips Self Tapping Screw

Countersunk head self tapping screw with Phillips drive

Phillips DriveBetter Grip
CSK HeadFlush Finish
Sharp ThreadFast & Secure Fit
WIRE GRADES204Cu | 304 | 316

Product Overview

Flat countersunk head screws with a sharp thread and pointed tip that tap their own mating thread in sheet metal, aluminium, plastic and timber. The Phillips recess gives positive driver engagement, while the countersunk head sits flush with the surface for a clean, snag-free finish.

Key Features

  • Head sits flush with the work surface
  • Sharp thread for faster installation
  • Phillips cross recess for better grip and torque transfer
  • Corrosion-resistant stainless steel construction

Typical Applications

Sheet metal panels, electrical enclosures, cabinets and furniture hardware, HVAC ducting, signage and general fabrication.

Drive TypePhillips cross recess
ThreadAB Type / B Type
StandardDIN / ISO
Wire Grades204Cu | 304 | 316
Size#4 – #10
Length9.5 mm – 100 mm

Thread Types

AB type: sharp, widely spaced thread with a gimlet point for thin sheet metal and plastics.
B type: blunt point with a finer thread for thicker sheet metal.
